description: On the green-covered bed in front of you is a small white plastic piece shaped like an upside-down cup sitting on a square base, with a large blue pillow behind it. The left hand moves forward to steady the base while the right hand reaches in to grasp the cup-shaped cover, lifting it upward and slightly right to remove it and set it down beside the base, revealing a ball-shaped post on the stand; both hands then release and pull back.
